61:["$","h2","58",{"id":"frequently-asked-questions","children":"Frequently Asked Questions"}]
62:["$","p","59",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Is blue and white good for productivity?</strong>"}}]
63:["$","p","60",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Yes, more than most palettes. Blue lowers heart rate and reduces stimulation, which helps sustained focus. White reflects light and reduces eye strain. The pairing is the single best for sustained desk work."}}]
64:["$","p","61",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>What white works best with blue?</strong>"}}]
65:["$","p","62",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Cream-white (warm) for navy and slate blue. Bright pure white (cool) for sky and cobalt blue. Avoid yellowish off-whites with blue — they read dirty."}}]
66:["$","p","63",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>Can I use other accent colors with blue and white?</strong>"}}]
67:["$","p","64",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"One small accent color is fine — gold, brass, or a soft natural wood. Two accents start to dilute the blue-and-white identity. Three and you've lost the look entirely."}}]
68:["$","p","65",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"<strong>What plants work with a blue and white setup?</strong>"}}]
69:["$","p","66",{"dangerouslySetInnerHTML":{"__html":"Sansevieria (snake plant), olive trees (small), eucalyptus stems, white orchids. Avoid bright florals (pink, orange) — they fight the palette."}}]
